definitions.explanation: The completion of a financial transaction or payment.

examples.japanese: クレジットカードで{決済|けっさい}する。
{電子|でんし}{決済|けっさい}が{普及|ふきゅう}している。
{決済|けっさい}が{完了|かんりょう}しました。

notes:
The completion of a financial transaction. A compound of {決|けつ} (settle) + {済|さい} (finish). More formal and technical than {支払|しはら}い (payment).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {決済|けっさい}{方法|ほうほう}: payment method
- {電子|でんし}{決済|けっさい}: electronic payment
- キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}: cashless payment
- {決済|けっさい}{完了|かんりょう}: payment completed
- {決済|けっさい}する: to complete a payment

MODERN USAGE:
Very common in e-commerce, fintech, and POS systems. QRコード{決済|けっさい} (QR code payment) has become widespread in Japan.

HOMOPHONE:
{決裁|けっさい} means "approval/authorization" (different kanji, different meaning).
